name: Proximity: covered skin 2-14 mm from the metal while following (user 2026-10-15: pass at 14 mm, aim for 10)
judge: full-exo/score_design.py BAND_HI=14 (exact posed skin, 30 fps clips)

name: Aim: the same at 2-10 mm (the 1 cm rule)
No part enters the body, any frame of any clip
Follows the arm (frames tracked, not held at a limit)
Overhead works (Raise overhead clip score) (14 mm band)
Shoulder-chain DOF from the scapula base to the arm, counted kinematically (cap 4; the user's scapula handler is a separate part)
No interference between parts that move relative to each other
Every custom part is one valid closed solid
judge: judge/part_validity.py (OCC BRepCheck on the exported STEP)

name: Custom-part mass budget (user: 500 g for the shoulder)
Strength: SF >= 1.5 at 25 N.m worst direction; deflection and fatigue bounded
judge: independent FEA (CalculiX) - only the in-house hex8 study exists (pipeline/conformal/thin_study)

name: Base rides the scapula on the user's scapula handler: worst GH misalignment from base slip over the bone (4 mm, confirmed)
judge: judge/base_mount.py (girdle mount: skin-slip model to build; the thorax-plate check stays for designs with a thorax base)

name: Interface pressure under ISO/TS 15066 body-region limits
judge: coupled human-exo contact sim (MuJoCo/Drake) then pressure film / FSRs on a prototype

name: CAD standard: G2 surfaces, flat seats under every seat, no visible screws or seams
Manufacturable
judge: supplier DFM review + quote (CNC Ti / 7075, SLM AlSi10Mg)

name: Generalises: holds on motions and body shapes never used to design it
judge: held-out OpenCap / AMASS clips and SMPL-X bodies (data/raw)

name: Works on real bodies
judge: printed prototype on the user + one very different body: OpenCap reach vs bare arm, zero skin-contact on FSR strips

name: Follows the functional everyday workspace (built design: chain closes, no body contact, no part interference)
judge: judge/workspace.py (L1 CAD over the functional workspace poses; user: 90 % range first)

name: Moves freely unpowered (MVP1): the arm drives the chain through every clip, peak <= 1 N.m about the shoulder, <= 5 N and <= 5 deg at the cuff, no stall, no undriven spare joint
judge: judge/dynamics.py (MuJoCo 3.16; rolling bearings mu 0.005; load-dependent friction; validated in judge/test_dynamics.py)
